text: When a family says yes to a membership during the visit, enroll the pet right there, so today's visit gets member prices.
Remember: Enroll charges the card today and bills it every month after, so read the amount to the owner before you click.
On Juniper's chart, in the Membership section, click Enroll in a plan.
Hand the screen to the owner. They read the agreement first.
It covers each plan, the twelve-month commitment, and what happens if they cancel early.
Enrolling prices today's visit at member rates, and Stripe bills the membership from then on.
Next, the card for the membership. If the family has a card on file, you can use it. Maria doesn't, so type the name on her card,
Scout only lists plans for Juniper's species and age. Pick Feline Foundations, monthly, fifty-nine dollars.
Scout confirms the amount: fifty-nine dollars today, then every month. Read it to Maria.
Juniper is a member. Benefits are available right away, and the membership is billed on Maria's card.

The most common mistakes: enrolling before the owner has heard the amount, and picking a plan for the wrong pet. Remember: Enroll charges the card today and bills it every month after, so read the amount to the owner before you click.
